component_positions.part_name: ECG Analog Front End (24-bit, single lead)

checks.title: ECG lead vector is long enough to resolve
checks.message: ELEC_A and ELEC_B are only 16.00 mm apart, 35 mm required.
checks.rationale: A single-lead ECG measures the potential difference between two electrodes. The signal amplitude scales with how much of the heart's dipole the pair spans, so electrodes placed close together produce a small, low-amplitude trace that no amount of gain recovers cleanly. 35 mm is the practical floor for a chest patch.

checks.title: LIPO is clear of heat source REG
checks.message: LIPO sits 1.50 mm from REG (edge gap) but needs 8 mm. Short by 6.50 mm.
checks.rationale: Sustained heat accelerates lithium cell ageing and lowers the thermal runaway threshold. Inside a sealed patch the cell has no convective path, so heat that reaches it stays there for the whole wear duration.
checks.suggestion: Move LIPO at least 6.50 mm further from REG.

checks.title: ELEC_B stays cool enough for skin contact (REG)
checks.message: ELEC_B sits 13.50 mm from REG (edge gap) but needs 15 mm. Short by 1.50 mm.
checks.rationale: IEC 60601-1 caps prolonged patient skin contact at 43 C. This patch is worn continuously for days against bare skin, so a dissipating part near a skin-contact surface is a burn exposure, and the local heating also drives electrode half-cell potential drift into the measurement.
checks.suggestion: Move ELEC_B at least 1.50 mm further from REG.

checks.title: CHARGE is reachable through the enclosure
checks.message: CHARGE does not line up with opening 'charge_window': 86.00 mm deep, beyond reach.
checks.rationale: The patch is sealed for moisture ingress, so the gasketed charge window is the only external interface after assembly. Pads that do not register with that window mean the device cannot be charged and cannot be serviced.
checks.suggestion: Shift CHARGE to register with opening 'charge_window'.

checks.title: AFE is clear of noise source MCU
checks.message: AFE sits 4.95 mm from MCU (edge gap) but needs 15 mm. Short by 10.05 mm.
checks.rationale: The ECG signal arriving at the front end is roughly 1 mV, and the patch's buck converter switches within millimetres of it on the same copper. Capacitively coupled switching noise at that scale does not degrade the trace, it buries the QRS complex outright, and no amount of downstream gain or filtering recovers it.
checks.suggestion: Move AFE at least 10.05 mm further from MCU.

checks.title: AFE is clear of noise source REG
checks.message: AFE sits 6.00 mm from REG (edge gap) but needs 15 mm. Short by 9.00 mm.
checks.rationale: The ECG signal arriving at the front end is roughly 1 mV, and the patch's buck converter switches within millimetres of it on the same copper. Capacitively coupled switching noise at that scale does not degrade the trace, it buries the QRS complex outright, and no amount of downstream gain or filtering recovers it.
checks.suggestion: Move AFE at least 9.00 mm further from REG.

checks.title: ELEC_B is clear of noise source MCU
checks.message: ELEC_B sits 11.40 mm from MCU (edge gap) but needs 12 mm. Short by 0.60 mm.
checks.rationale: The ECG signal arriving at the front end is roughly 1 mV, and the patch's buck converter switches within millimetres of it on the same copper. Capacitively coupled switching noise at that scale does not degrade the trace, it buries the QRS complex outright, and no amount of downstream gain or filtering recovers it.
checks.suggestion: Move ELEC_B at least 0.60 mm further from MCU.

checks.title: AFE is clear of heat source REG
checks.message: AFE sits 6.00 mm from REG (edge gap) but needs 10 mm. Short by 4.00 mm.
checks.rationale: A 24-bit front end resolves well under a microvolt per count. Package self-heating from a neighbouring part drifts its input offset and bias currents, and that drift appears in the recording as baseline wander that looks like respiration or motion artifact.
checks.suggestion: Move AFE at least 4.00 mm further from REG.

checks.title: AFE is outside the REG heat zone
checks.message: AFE reaches 2.50 mm inside the 10 mm thermal zone around REG.
checks.rationale: Simplified thermal model: a fixed radius standing in for the elevated temperature region around the regulator, covering heat spread through the copper pour rather than just the package body. This is a geometric proxy, not a solved thermal field.
checks.suggestion: Move AFE 2.50 mm further from REG, or cut REG dissipation.

checks.title: ANT antenna keep-out is clear
checks.message: The 8 mm keep-out ahead of ANT is obstructed by: trace charge_run.
checks.rationale: A chip antenna radiates into the volume ahead of it. Copper, a pouch cell, or any bulk dielectric inside that volume detunes the match and absorbs radiated power. Inside a sealed patch there is no way to retune after assembly.
checks.suggestion: Clear trace charge_run out of the ANT keep-out, or point the antenna at open space.
